scope: Real R13 search presentation and derived mobile/media search flows

checks.name: Measured source styles and geometry
checks.observation: Before checks reproduced wrong colors, close glyph/size, avatars and highlight. Paragraph inspection found members-p muted/13/18 leakage. After source properties and eight measured boxes pass; mobile close/label areas remain 44 px with source SVG alignment.

checks.name: Frozen PNG comparison
checks.observation: Full MAE 3.659 to 3.056; search area 3.637 to 1.173; first result 5.191 to 1.996. Reference hash unchanged.

checks.name: HTML renderer control
checks.observation: Actual vs rendered handoff search MAE 0.031, first result 0.018. Same rendered HTML vs PNG is 1.164/1.991; sources do not match exactly in this renderer.

checks.name: Real search and media browser flows
checks.observation: Scope, safe highlights, result opening and mobile label focus pass. ScreenViewer desktop header/overflow search and mobile keyboard/open/close preserve selected MediaStream. No page errors.

checks.name: Native Web validation
checks.observation: Focused 6 files/12 tests and full Web 297 files/940 tests pass. TypeScript/Vite build and git diff --check pass.

checks.name: Full-design and physical media acceptance
checks.observation: Strict full-design pixel equality remains open; derived mobile search has no separate PNG golden. Canvas fixture verification does not prove physical LiveKit.
